summary: Frontend-only performance fix verification for Home.jsx hover preview & scroll. All 6 functional requirements PASS. Throttled mousemove via requestAnimationFrame + direct DOM transform manipulation confirmed working. Preview visibility, follow-cursor behavior, edge-switching, dismissal and click-through navigation verified.
action_items: Minor (non-blocking): Console warning observed - 'Invalid DOM property class. Did you mean className' somewhere in the page. Not introduced by this fix but should be cleaned up.
Code-quality: Project rows in the work list (#work .cursor-pointer) have no data-testid attribute. Adding e.g. data-testid="work-row-{index}" would make automated regression testing more robust.

Performance during synthetic high-frequency scroll burst (16ms wheel ticks + mousemove) shows 3 long tasks and max frame ~133ms (avg 23.9ms, p95 66.6ms). This is dominated by the synthetic scroll itself; baseline (no scroll) is a clean 60fps (avg 16.6ms). The rAF throttling is working correctly - no further action strictly required, but if jank is still visible to the user under real-world scrolling, consider also throttling the IntersectionObserver-driven reveal cascade.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is 1241 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline. Should be split into smaller section components (Hero, WorkList, About, etc.) for maintainability.
handleRowMouseMove correctly cancels prior rAF via rafIdRef and uses direct DOM mutation on previewImageRef.current.style.transform - avoids React re-renders during mousemove. Good.
handleRowMouseLeave correctly cancels any pending rAF to avoid stale transform writes after the preview unmounts. Good.

The preview div is conditionally rendered ({hoverPreview.isVisible && ...}). On the very first frame after mount the transform is empty (translate not yet applied) so the preview briefly renders at (0,0) before the first rAF runs. Minor visual nit; opacity transition typically masks it but could be improved by initializing transform inline using last-known cursor position stored in a ref.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All hover-preview functional requirements verified on desktop viewport 1920x1080 at https://ajay-portfolio-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified: (1) preview hidden initially, (2) preview opacity 0.45 + willChange 'transform, opacity' + aspect 3/1 + img present on hover, (3) transform updates as cursor moves (rAF-throttled), (4) right-side cursor (x>60% viewport) flips preview to left of cursor (offsetX = x-444), left-side adds +24, (5) preview unmounts on mouseleave, (6) click on row navigates to /project/{id}. Performance: baseline 60fps clean; synthetic scroll burst shows expected minor frame drops but no excessive long tasks. There are 8 project rows in the work list. No data-testid attributes - selectors used '#work .cursor-pointer'.
rca of the issue: Original stutter root cause was per-pixel mousemove events triggering React setState -> reconciliation on every mouse move (potentially hundreds/sec). Fix correctly addresses it via: (1) rAF throttling (caps to ~60Hz), (2) direct DOM style.transform mutation bypassing React, (3) keeping React state only for isVisible/currentImage (low-frequency), (4) will-change: transform, opacity for GPU compositing. Verified working in browser.
